resources.title: RCC IS 456 Limit State Design Formula & Code Cheatsheet
resources.description: Original handbook summarizing IS 456:2000 provisions for Singly & Doubly Reinforced Beams, Shear reinforcement, Bond stress, and T-Beam design.
resources.bestFor: RCC design midterms, final exam problems and IS 456 reference

resources.title: Soil Mechanics & Geotechnical Phase Relations Quick Guide
resources.description: Original study guide covering 3-phase soil diagrams, void ratio, porosity, degree of saturation, Terzaghi effective stress, and Mohr-Coulomb shear strength.
resources.bestFor: Geotechnical engineering formulas and university vivas

resources.title: Structural Analysis Moment Distribution & Slope Deflection Reference
resources.description: Original step-by-step solver guide for Hardy Cross Moment Distribution Method, Slope Deflection equations, and Castigliano energy theorems.

resources.title: NPTEL Structural Analysis - I by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. Amit Shaw video lectures covering determinacy, influence lines, trusses, energy methods, and displacement methods for indeterminate frames.
resources.bestFor: Structural analysis methods and frame deflection

resources.title: NPTEL Soil Mechanics by IIT Bombay
resources.description: Prof. D. N. Singh complete video course on origin of soils, soil classification (USCS/IS), compaction, consolidation theory, and shear strength tests.
resources.bestFor: Soil mechanics and geotechnical foundation design

resources.title: NPTEL Design of Reinforced Concrete Structures by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. Nirjhar Dhang lectures on working stress vs limit state methods, flexure of beams, shear and torsion, columns, and isolated footings.
resources.bestFor: Concrete structure design conforming to IS 456

resources.title: NPTEL Surveying by IIT Roorkee
resources.description: Prof. B. C. Raymahashay covering chain surveying, compass traversing, leveling, contouring, theodolite surveying, and Total Station technology.
resources.bestFor: Surveying field procedures and contour leveling

resources.title: NPTEL Environmental Engineering by IIT Madras
resources.description: Prof. Ligy Philip covering water quality parameters, water treatment units (coagulation, sedimentation, filtration, disinfection), and sewage networks.
resources.bestFor: Water supply engineering and wastewater treatment design

resources.title: MIT 1.050 Engineering Mechanics I
resources.description: MIT OCW course on equilibrium of deformable bodies, stress tensor, strain compatibility, elastic energy, and beam theories.
resources.bestFor: Solid mechanics theory and stress equilibrium

resources.title: MIT 1.011 Project Management
resources.description: MIT course on construction project life cycle, scheduling with CPM/PERT, resource leveling, risk analysis, and contract administration.

resources.title: NPTEL Transportation Engineering - I by IIT Roorkee
resources.description: Prof. Manoranjan Parida covering highway alignment, geometric design (SSD, OSD, horizontal curves, superelevation), and pavement design (IRC 37).
resources.bestFor: Highway geometric design and traffic engineering

resources.title: NPTEL Design of Steel Structures by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. S. R. Satish Kumar lectures on IS 800:2007 limit state method, bolted and welded connections, tension members, compression members, and plate girders.
resources.bestFor: Steel structure design according to IS 800 standards

resources.title: The Constructor Civil Engineering Knowledge Portal
resources.description: Global civil engineering guide featuring articles on concrete testing (slump, compressive strength), foundation types, and building construction codes.
resources.bestFor: Site execution practices and concrete mix design

resources.title: NPTEL Advanced Hydraulics by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Lectures on open channel flow, specific energy, hydraulic jump, gradually varied flow profiles (M and S curves), and hydraulic machinery.
resources.bestFor: Open channel flow and hydraulic jump derivations

resources.title: CivilDigital Online Civil Engineering Repository
resources.description: Educational platform with structural analysis calculators, geotechnical design charts, and technical seminar topics.
resources.bestFor: Student design spreadsheets and revision summaries
